meta.statut: silver — à promouvoir en gold par revue

questions.question: Quel type d'événement est le plus fréquent ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false RETURN t.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Combien d'incidents impliquant EasyJet ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:IMPLIQUE_COMPAGNIE]->(c:Compagnie) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND c.nom='EASYJET' RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS ans

questions.question: Quelle phase de vol concentre le plus d'incidents ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(p:PhaseVol) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false RETURN p.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Parmi les incidents graves, quelle phase de vol domine ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(p:PhaseVol) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND i.severite IN ['4 - élevé','5 - intolérable'] RETURN p.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Parmi les incidents de nuit, quel type est le plus fréquent ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND i.condition_lumineuse='Nuit' RETURN t.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Parmi les incidents avec blessés, quelle phase domine ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(p:PhaseVol) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND i.presence_blesses=true RETURN p.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quelle compagnie est la plus impliquée dans les collisions aviaires ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(:TypeEvenement {label:'Collision aviaire'}) MATCH (i)-[:IMPLIQUE_COMPAGNIE]->(c:Compagnie) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false RETURN c.nom AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Sur quel lieu surviennent le plus les incidents au décollage ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(:PhaseVol {label:'Décollage'}) MATCH (i)-[:LOCALISE_EN]->(l:Lieu) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false RETURN l.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quel facteur contributif domine les quasi-collisions avion/véhicule ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND t.label CONTAINS 'Quasi-collision' AND t.label CONTAINS 'véhicule' MATCH (i)-[:A_POUR_FACTEUR]->(f:FacteurContributif) RETURN f.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quel type d'aéronef est le plus impliqué dans les incidents graves ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:IMPLIQUE_AERONEF]->(a:TypeAeronef) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND i.severite IN ['4 - élevé','5 - intolérable'] RETURN a.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Pour les incidents graves au roulage, quel facteur contributif domine ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(:PhaseVol {label:'Roulage'}) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND i.severite IN ['4 - élevé','5 - intolérable'] MATCH (i)-[:A_POUR_FACTEUR]->(f:FacteurContributif) RETURN f.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quelle compagnie a le plus de collisions aviaires survenues la nuit ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(:TypeEvenement {label:'Collision aviaire'}) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND i.condition_lumineuse='Nuit' MATCH (i)-[:IMPLIQUE_COMPAGNIE]->(c:Compagnie) RETURN c.nom AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Pour les incursions de piste, quel facteur contributif est le plus fréquent ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(:TypeEvenement {label:'Incursion sur piste ou voie de circulation'}) MATCH (i)-[:A_POUR_FACTEUR]->(f:FacteurContributif) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false RETURN f.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Parmi les incidents avec défaut de communication, quel type d'événement domine ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:A_POUR_FACTEUR]->(:FacteurContributif {label:'defaut_communication'}) MATCH (i)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false RETURN t.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quel service est responsable du plus grand nombre d'incidents graves ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:RESPONSABLE]->(s:Service) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND i.severite IN ['4 - élevé','5 - intolérable'] RETURN s.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Si on excluait les FOD et les collisions aviaires (aléas), quel type serait le plus fréquent ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND NOT t.label IN ['FOD','Collision aviaire','Collision animale'] RETURN t.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: En ne gardant que les incidents graves, quel lieu domine ?
questions.chemin_raisonnement: gravité ∩ lieu → argmax (à comparer au lieu dominant global = Piste)
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:LOCALISE_EN]->(l:Lieu) WHERE coalesce(i.is_test_data,false)=false AND i.severite IN ['4 - élevé','5 - intolérable'] RETURN l.label AS ans, count(DISTINCT i) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quel facteur contributif est le plus dangereux (plus forte part d'incidents graves) ?
questions.chemin_raisonnement: par facteur : part de graves → argmax du taux (seuil n≥30)
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:A_POUR_FACTEUR]->(f:FacteurContributif) WITH f.label AS fac, count(DISTINCT i) AS n, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.severite IN ['4 - élevé','5 - intolérable'] THEN i END) AS g WHERE n>=30 RETURN fac AS ans, 100.0*g/n AS pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quel type d'événement a la plus forte proportion d'incidents graves ?
questions.chemin_raisonnement: par type : part de graves → argmax du taux (seuil n≥50)
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:DE_TYPE]->(t:TypeEvenement) WITH t.label AS typ, count(DISTINCT i) AS n, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.severite IN ['4 - élevé','5 - intolérable'] THEN i END) AS g WHERE n>=50 RETURN typ AS ans, 100.0*g/n AS pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Quelle phase de vol est proportionnellement la plus grave ?
questions.chemin_raisonnement: par phase : part de graves → argmax du taux
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i:IncidentSecu)-[:EN_PHASE_DE_VOL]->(p:PhaseVol) WITH p.label AS ph, count(DISTINCT i) AS n, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.severite IN ['4 - élevé','5 - intolérable'] THEN i END) AS g WHERE n>=50 RETURN ph AS ans, 100.0*g/n AS pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1
